subject: MIXING VALVES

items.label: Cold-water failure test — outlet temperature falls, does not spike
items.note: The defining safety behaviour of a mixing valve: on loss of cold, it must not deliver full hot.

items.label: Hot-water failure test — outlet does not deliver full cold where the application forbids it
Checkstops / integral checks proven — no cross-flow between hot and cold
Outlet temperature at the furthest fixture served (°C)
items.convergence_reason: FIRM PRACTICE — fifty years of Isotherm field practice, cited as the anchor because the code set is silent here. Not dressed as a standard. The valve is commissioned at the valve and judged at the tap.

items.label: Inlet hot / cold temperatures at test (°C)
